metadata.fareBasis: Official Eastern Railway suburban second-class fare chart
metadata.fareChartPublished: Eastern Railway Combined Suburban Time Table, 2015
metadata.lastConfirmedUnchangedBy: Ministry of Railways fare notification effective 2025-12-26

coverage.note: The published Eastern Railway chart provides this suburban second-class table up to 500 km. Do not extrapolate beyond 500 km.

fareRules.childAgeRule: Eastern Railway chart states children above 5 years and under 12 years are charged half the corresponding adult fare.
fareRules.childFareCalculation: Half of the adult fare for the applicable distance slab; confirm applicable rounding at ticket issuance.

additionalCharges.gst: No separate GST amount is specified for this ordinary suburban unreserved fare table; apply only if an applicable current railway instruction requires it.

bookingAgentCommission.appliesWhen: Only when ticket is purchased through an authorised JTBS agent, as stated in the cited older Eastern Railway timetable; verify current instructions before applying.

fareRules.rounding: Use the fare printed/quoted by the current UTS/PRS or booking system where available. Do not invent rounding rules for child fares.
fareRules.distanceRule: Use the railway-approved route distance between the origin and destination, not straight-line distance.
